Sometimes I Scare Myself by Jeneva Rose has all the ingredients for a delightfully spooky read:

📖 A collection of chilling stories
🔮 A séance gone wrong
🏚️ A haunted house
🌲 A cabin in the woods

If supernatural suspense and eerie encounters are your kind of thing, consider https://t.co/b6kKkNh6mc
Nobody is ever too old for Dog Man, right? Dog Man: A Sprinkle in Time is officially here. Grab your copy at Books-A-Million! https://t.co/tjTOO7SN6t
If you're looking for us, we'll be with A Court of Splintered Harmony 💗 https://t.co/w3rtAyNvv8

'Motherland: A Jamaican Cookbook' charts the history of the people, influences and ingredients that uniquely united to create Jamaican cuisine. It features delicious classic recipes, such as saltfish fritters, curry goat and patties. Find out more today: https://t.co/OCpviaWOHv https://t.co/rBx74l6lSZ
